filament_notes: GeeeTech PETG 1.75 mm, 1 kg, any colour; normal and fast printing (the clear/glass look is in GeeeTech PETG Transparent). Geeetech and 3DJake: nozzle 220-240 C, bed 80-90 C; density 1.27 (Open Filament Database). Tune: 245/250 C, flow 0.98 and spool 193 g from your GeeeTech tune, cap 18 mm3/s between Prusa Generic PETG INDX HF0.4 (240 C, 17) and Prusament PETG INDX (250 C, 20), fan 30-65 percent and retract 1.6 as Prusa INDX PETG, PA 0.055 between Prusa Generic (0.052) and Prusament (0.058). Raise the cap with a max-flow test. T8 version for the 1.0 mm high-flow nozzle: Prusa has no 1.0 PETG, so temperature, cap and fan follow Prusa Prusament PETG @COREONE HF0.8 (260 C, 37 mm3/s, fan 30-65, bridges 65, layer time 20/35 s) scaled to this filament and to INDX; pressure advance is the 0.4 value x0.447 (Prusa 0.4 to 0.8 ratio) x0.69 (0.8 to 1.0 step used for the CF profiles). Raise the cap with a max-flow test.
